candidateSegments.teachingRole: Path and endpoint displacement; concrete opening before average/instantaneous rate.

observed.before: Mario is on the right side of a tiled room.
observed.action: He crosses toward the left pipe, travels along the wall, then comes back toward the middle.
observed.result: The traveled route bends and covers more distance than the direct start-to-end separation.

claimLimits: This is not an exact closed loop; do not narrate final displacement as exactly zero.
Floor tiles are visual landmarks, not calibrated metres. Camera movement must not be treated as character velocity.

annotationPlan.target: Character feet/start-end landmarks and progressively drawn observed path; keep pipe/UI visible.
annotationPlan.style: Progressive open contour/short leader/path with labels. No invented game measurements or internal force/skeleton data.
annotationPlan.tracking: These inspected sample frames are planning evidence, not per-frame tracking. Follow actual target; hide at occlusion/out-of-frame; clear at cut.
annotationPlan.captionClearance: Fixed bottom-centre captions and game UI protected; foreground callout should not cover the action.

candidateSegments.status: Concept observed in native-source temporal frames; full continuous playback, audio and final tracked composite QA pending

candidateSegments.teachingRole: Actual speed display changes while vehicle position progresses; bridge interval averages to instantaneous rate.

observed.action: Car accelerates among other cars and follows the road; visible speed readout grows with a brief drop around the turn.
observed.result: Speed readout and traveled position are different quantities.

claimLimits: Speedometer unit is mph, not km/h; observed24@6s,56@8s,100@12s,96@13s,131@22s.
Contacts near9–12s mean this is not a controlled constant-acceleration run.
Do not infer throttle/brake inputs, true derivative implementation or exact acceleration from display.

annotationPlan.target: Short leader to speedometer at lower-right without covering digits; optional trail attached to road landmarks, no fabricated physical values.

candidateSegments.teachingRole: Same object can be almost still relative to a raft and moving relative to shore.

observed.before: Link stands beside the mast on a log raft already moving across water.
observed.action: Raft sails along the bank; camera orbits while Link remains by the mast.
observed.result: Link and raft move together while shoreline landmarks pass.

claimLimits: Do not say Link walks across the raft; he mostly stands.
Camera rotation is separate from world motion; lock explanatory anchors to mast/feet and visible shoreline.
Exact raft speed/wind/buoyancy algorithm not measured. Use source train/person arithmetic only in our labelled model.

annotationPlan.target: Foot-to-mast short bracket stays with raft; shoreline landmark label only while visible, remove through camera orbit.
